originalTitle: Update: US Equity Indexes Edge Up as Treasury Yields Fall From Highest in Two Decades After October Fed Rate-Increase Bets Drop
summary: (Updates with index/price moves and geopolitical news from the first paragraph.) US equity indexe
content: (Updates with index/price moves and geopolitical news from the first paragraph.) US equity indexes ground higher Thursday as pressure from government bond yields eased after odds favoring a back-to-back monetary policy tightening in October faded. The S&P 500 climbed 0.2% to 7,666.45, the Nasdaq Composite rose less than 0.1% to 26,871.60, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged up less than 0.1% to 50,926.56. Sector moves were evenly spread, with industrials leading while healthcare paced the decliners at the close. The Institute for Supply Management's US manufacturing index fell to 54.5 in September from 54.6 in August, compared with the 55.0 forecast in a Bloomberg-compiled survey. The S&P Global US manufacturing index for September was revised to 55.9 from the flash reading of 57.0, versus expectations for no revision in a Bloomberg-compiled poll. The 10-year government bond yield dropped 5.4 basis points to 5.24%, after reaching an intraday peak of 5.344%, its highest since 2002. The 30-year rate fell 3.1 basis points to 5.61%, after hitting its strongest level since 2002 earlier in the day. The 2-year yield slumped 10.4 basis points to 4.78%. Traders slashed the near-term probability of the Federal Reserve raising its target rate by 25 basis points in October to 26% from 69% a week ago, data from the CME Fedwatch tool showed Thursday. In company news, Micron Technology (MU) reported a year-over-year jump in fiscal Q4 adjusted earnings and revenue, and set out fiscal Q1 guidance above consensus estimates late Wednesday. Still, shares declined 1.9%. Accenture (ACN) reported stronger-than-expected fiscal Q4 results on Thursday, and forecast annual earnings and revenue growth in the fiscal year that just began. Shares surged 16%, the top gainer on the S&P 500. Paramount Skydance (PSKY) CEO David Ellison has asked CNN CEO Mark Thompson to remain in his role after Paramount completes its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. Paramount shares sank 9.6%, the S&P 500's worst performer. By the end of November, which is after the US mid-term elections, three aircraft carriers and two landing groups will be deployed around Iran, a US official told Al Jazeera, a Middle Eastern broadcaster. Iran is preparing a broader and more forceful response if the US resumes large-scale military attacks, while continuing a diplomatic push that Iranian officials privately see as unlikely to succeed, unnamed sources told Reuters. Meanwhile, a Saudi Arabia-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed four drones launched by Iran-aligned Houthi militant group over the southern part of the Kingdom, Al Jazeera reported. The front-month US West Texas Intermediate crude oil contract jumped 2.8% to $92.98 per barrel, and the global benchmark North Sea Brent advanced 4.5% to $102.40 per barrel.
chineseTitle: 更新：十月美联储加息押注下降后，随着美国国债收益率从二十年来的最高点回落，美国股指小幅上涨
chineseSummary: （第一段中的指数/价格变动和地缘政治新闻更新。）美国股票指数
chineseContent: （第一段中的指数/价格变动和地缘政治新闻的更新。）周四美国股指走高，因为政府债券收益率的压力在十月份连续收紧货币政策的可能性消退后有所缓解。标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.2%，至 7,666.45 点；纳斯达克综合指数上涨不到 0.1%，至 26,871.60 点；道琼斯工业平均指数微升不到 0.1%，至 50,926.56 点。收盘时，各板块走势均匀，工业板块领涨，医疗保健板块跌幅居前。供应管理协会的美国制造业指数从 8 月的 54.6 降至 9 月的 54.5，而彭博社编制的调查预测为 55.0。 9 月份标准普尔全球美国制造业指数从初值 57.0 修正至 55.9，而彭博社编制的民意调查预期没有修正。 10年期国债收益率下跌5.4个基点至5.24%，盘中触及2002年以来最高点5.344%。30年期国债收益率下跌3.1个基点至5.61%，当天早些时候触及2002年以来最高水平。 2年期国债收益率下跌10.4个基点至4.78%。 CME Fedwatch 工具周四显示的数据显示，交易员将美联储 10 月份目标利率上调 25 个基点的近期可能性从一周前的 69% 下调至 26%。公司新闻方面，美光科技 (MU) 报告称，第四财季调整后盈利和收入同比大幅增长，并在周三晚间公布了第一财季指引，高于市场普遍预期。尽管如此，股价仍下跌 1.9%。埃森哲（ACN）周四公布了强于预期的第四季度财报，并预测刚刚开始的财年的年度盈利和收入增长。股价飙升 16%，成为标准普尔 500 指数涨幅最大的股票。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
